featured_reviews.name: Sameer Ghadi
featured_reviews.review_text:
5/5 Stars – Perfect Maharashtrian Catering for Ganesh Jayanti Feast!
We ordered from Santosh Catering for Ganesh Jayanti on 22-01-2026, and it was flawless! Parcel service for lunch (30 people) and dinner (50 people) – both deliveries were super smooth and right on time.
Lunch Menu (30 pax): Paneer Lazeez, Sukha Batata Bhaji, Chapati (3 per person), Jeera Rice, Dal Fry, Koshimbir, Papad, Achar. Every item was delicious, fresh, and packed with authentic Maharashtrian flavors – the Paneer Lazeez was a highlight! Best part: completely soda-free (no baking soda powder), so all tastes were pure and natural.
Dinner Menu (50 pax): Veg Kolhapuri, Bhendi Masala, Chapati (3 per person), Jeera Rice, Dal Fry, Koshimbir, Papad, Achar. The Veg Kolhapuri had the perfect spicy kick, and portions were generous for our big group – again, soda-free for genuine flavors.
Prices are very reasonable for the quality and variety, making it ideal for celebrations. Highly recommend – Santosh Catering nailed it!

featured_reviews.name: Raviraj Samant
featured_reviews.review_text:
Positives:
1. The food taste was good.
2. The decoration was nice.

Negatives:
1. The manager literally coerced me to give a 5 star review. Well! You better give me a good service for that but HELL NO! THEY DIDN'T!
2. The servers with starters just did NOT come to the row where we were seated, which was RIGHT NEXT to where they were entering from.
3. I told the manager herself, and the other boy who was sub-manager, not once or twice but multiple times, and even then they didn't give us starters even 1 damn time!
4. I agree, we were here for the function and not just for the food. But if you are behind my back for a review, might as well provide a good service.

So overall, I really would not recommend their services. I'm sorry, if you check my other reviews I am mostly very considerate.

But these guys just didn't listen to my request at all. They just kept on bringing water and juice. What do you want me to do? Overdose on liquids and keep peeing?

Also there were barely any chairs for us to have lunch. And I had to keep my plate next to the person who was collecting used plates. Nice!

So my sincere request to them is that please instruct your robotic like serving staff to apply some brains as to where to serve next instead of going to the same place like ants. While I agree that every profession should be respected but then do it properly and not for the sake of it or atleast your manager should observe it.

1 star is for their taste of food and the other is for the decoration. That's it. You asked me how were the starters without even serving me and gave me 1 paneer tikka to review and never to come back again. 😂 Hilarious!

featured_reviews.name: Sampada Gorivale
featured_reviews.review_text:
Very disappointed with the food taste wise.
We ordered -
Paneer matar  - After giving specific instructions not to make the sabji salty it was salty and watery. No tomato onion gravy base was use which is the basic base for any punjabi gravy.... it was simple gravy like matki usal. Paneer was stale. Peas were not cooked properly.
Yellow batata bhaaji - Exact opposite of paneer matar bhajji no salt and taste wise also so so.
Masale bhaat - Not at all moist, all dried up.
Dal fry - No proper jeera tadka , watery like normal everyday dal nothing different than that.
Jeera rice - just simple rice and jeera boiled together.
Raita - the curd was watery and sweet without any salt. We had to add extra curd and seasoning to make it good.
Overall only veg cutlets, chutney and gulab jamun were good in the whole menu.

After giving review about the salt level of matar paneer one of the owner gave me a reasoning stating " The sabji was packed while it was warm and due to the heat it got reduce and thickened which caused the excessive saltiness in it". This explanation was the last straw for me. No logic at all!!!
Overall really disappointed with the service as the experience was unexpected because of all the previous good reviews.

featured_reviews.name: NANDINI MANKAR
featured_reviews.review_text:
Truly the best!
I had so much fun learning new recipes and new ways to cook dishes.
Bijal is very sweet and her passion for cooking truly is justified by her techniques!
Will highly recommend. I’m coming again for other cuisine!

featured_reviews.name: Dimple Chainani
featured_reviews.review_text:
We ordered the avocado cream cheese cucumber, the blue pea rice with mix veg and the tempura sushi.

Absolutely yummy sushi. It’s like an explosion of flavours in your mouth which keeps you craving more and more. The condiments provided were also top notch and complimented each type of sushi to perfection.

featured_reviews.name: Aditi Fagania
featured_reviews.review_text: I recently got the plain and peanut butter museli mix from BFC and in all honesty, I loved it. It has perfectly balanced flavours and not extra salty which I do not prefer. Clean ingredients and great mix! I had also got the granola bars which were amazing as welll!!

featured_reviews.name: Naële Marti
featured_reviews.review_text: Bijal is incredibly patient and a wonderful cook! We had such a lovely time with her. It’s a great way to experience authentic local cuisine in a real Indian home. She takes her time explaining each step and happily answers every question. And of course, the best part is enjoying the meal at the end! A beautiful experience to share with loved ones and a great opportunity to learn valuable cooking skills.

featured_reviews.name: Veruca S.
featured_reviews.review_text: Bijal’s cooking class was the only one in Mumbai that a solo traveler could sign up for (at least on that day), so I was really grateful to find it. She was very warm and accommodating, and upon learning my favorite dish, replaced one of her planned menu items with it so I could learn how to make it. Together we made palak paneer, dal tadka, jeera rice and garlic naan from scratch. Everything came out delicious! Bijal is an experienced teacher, and aside from how to make them, I learned how multiple dishes can be prepared efficiently. It was also helpful to see how she had her herbs and spices stored for practical use. I also really enjoyed our conversation after the meal. Highly recommended for anyone visiting Mumbai!

featured_reviews.name: roshni shah
featured_reviews.review_text: The sushi making class conducted by Mrs. Bijal was very informative and hands on. She explained each and every detail and also guided us where to buy the materials from. She was well prepared with all the ingredients needed. She thought us and made us eat with so much love which is the key ingredient to any cooking. Thank you so much Bijalji

featured_reviews.name: Shivani Paturkar
featured_reviews.review_text: My husband recently took the 5 day basic cooking class with Bijal aunty, and honestly, our home has never smelled better! 😄 My daughter and I feel truly blessed, he has come back with real skills and is now cooking the most delicious meals for us. Her teaching is clearly patient, practical, and filled with love, because the food he made tasted exactly that way. Thank you so much for this gift to our family! :D

featured_reviews.name: Anita Sharma
featured_reviews.review_text: A truly wonderful experience! Beyond the skills and knowledge shared, what stood out most was Bijalji herself. She is warm, humble, patient, and incredibly generous with her guidance. She creates such a comfortable and welcoming environment that learning feels effortless and enjoyable. It’s rare to meet someone so talented yet so kind and down-to-earth. Grateful for the experience and highly recommend learning from her.
